comment: Cold launch (main menu) into a solo skirmish on whatever the lobby was last set to. Client coordinates, 1080x720. Derived from screenshots rather than recorded, so each step is a named UI element: a failure names the button it could not reach. NOTE the main menu and the post-match skirmish lobby are DIFFERENT states at the same coordinates - (982,679) is empty space in the lobby and QUIT on the main menu, which is how an earlier blind replay closed the game.
